boundary: Actual source-built sample Startup, MVC endpoints, authorization middleware and cookie challenge through TestServer; no sockets or network-throughput claim.
matchedControl: Actual hosted request; harness decorator forces AllowsCachingPolicies=false in both source variants, not an unmodified application.
directControl: Actual uncached GetPolicyAsync call outside the endpoint policy cache.
observer: A lightweight forwarding provider counts actual named lookups with Interlocked.Increment; timing includes this harness-only observer.
dataProtection: Test-local ephemeral provider; no persistent key ring.
setup: Async warm requests completed in Program.Main before BDN; synchronous GlobalSetup only selects already-prepared scenarios.
